name: discord-role-permission-sync
description: Sync Takaro role membership, including roles synced from Discord, to game-server permission levels by running configurable console commands when players join.

enabled.description: Enable permission sync on player join.

rolePermissionMappings.description: Takaro role names to game permission levels. If Discord role sync creates/assigns Takaro roles, use those Takaro role names here. Lower permission numbers are more powerful in 7 Days to Die.

roleName.description: Takaro role name to match exactly, case-insensitive.

permissionLevel.description: Game permission level to apply when the player has this role. For 7D2D, lower numbers grant more access; 1000 is default/no access.

unmatchedPermissionLevel.description: Optional permission level to apply to players who do not match any role. Leave null to leave unmatched players unchanged.

commandTemplate.description: Console command template. Available placeholders: {playerGameId}, {playerName}, {permissionLevel}, {matchedRole}. Default is 7D2D's admin add command.

notifyPlayer.description: Privately notify the player after their permission level is synced.

notifyUnmatchedDiscordLink.description: Privately remind unmatched players to link Discord / ask staff if they expected a reserved-slot role.

matchedMessage.default: Your reserved-slot permission has been synced from role {matchedRole}.
matchedMessage.description: Private message sent when notifyPlayer is enabled and a mapping matched. Placeholders: {playerName}, {permissionLevel}, {matchedRole}.

unmatchedMessage.default: No reserved-slot role was found for you. If you are a supporter, make sure your Discord account is linked.
unmatchedMessage.description: Private message sent when notifyUnmatchedDiscordLink is enabled and no mapping matched.

dryRun.description: Log the command that would be executed without running it. Useful while setting up mappings.

sync-permission-on-join.description: Apply configured game permission level when a player joins based on their Takaro/Discord-synced role.
